note: The 2027 match schedule. Rounds, formats, courses, match counts and point values only — lineups live in Redis (lineups:2027), results come later. Course details (tees, rating, slope) are read from data/trip-2027.json by courseSlug; totals are computed in src/lib, never typed here.

teams.draftNote: Teams are drafted live on the night of Thursday 25 March in the Draft Room. Until then both sides are placeholders; FINALISE on /draft/commish fills in each side's team (name, colour, roster) at build time from data/draft.generated.json, and writes the rosters that restrict the lineup board. Nothing to edit here.

handicapRules.gross: No strokes: team gross score (as 2026's Round 1 scramble).
handicapRules.full-course: 100% course handicap for every player, from this round's course, our tees, rating and slope.
handicapRules.full-difference: 100% of the difference in course handicaps: the lower player plays off 0.

rounds.formatChange: New for 2027: the two partners' individual Stableford points are ADDED together and the higher combined total wins the match. (2026 used Team Average Stableford.)

rounds.championshipNote: Match 8 is the Championship Match: the individual title, worth 2 points like the other singles.
